title: 36 Hours in Helsinki, Finland
abstract: As Helsinki celebrates a major anniversary and its status as World Design Capital, spend a weekend discovering the city’s creative energy and its long, sun-soaked days.

title: 36 Hours in Providence, R.I.
abstract: Capital of the smallest state in the country, Providence can be easy to miss. But, spend a weekend there, and you’ll find top colleges, compelling culture and exceptional cuisine.

title: 36 Hours in Orléans, France
abstract: As this French city marks the 600th anniversary of Joan of Arc’s birth, discover what marks its present.

title: 36 Hours in Toronto
abstract: Canada’s largest city swirls together a vibrant mix of markets, music, museums and more. And summer might just be the best time to visit.
